correctness.rationale: For each exponent alpha_i dividing L, gcd(k,alpha_i) depends only on gcd(k,L). The gcd classes in one L-block have exact size phi(L/d). A smaller positive period T<L would force f_L=f_{L-T}=Omega(n), hence every alpha_i divides L-T and therefore L divides L-T, a contradiction. The extrema and mean follow by termwise gcd bounds and the standard finite gcd-sum identity. The bundled exhaustive regression check over 4,680 exponent tuples found no violation.

value.rationale: The result upgrades a published periodicity observation into a complete structural orbit theorem: exact least period, exact frequency of every attained value, sharp extremal fibers, and an exact first moment.
